directed_test_scope: The loads at offsets 0, 64 and 128 read three distinct 16-byte data-cache lines.

port_test.configuration: cv32a60x public CMI and AXI channel types, with 64-bit address/data, 4-bit IDs and 32-bit AXI user fields.
port_test.comparison_scope: Observe 9 port samples during an ordinary cacheable burst, an uncached read and an uncached load-reserved request. Check handshakes, ARLOCK, AR fields and success/error decoding for every RRESP value. The 39 CPU programs run after the port test passes.
port_test.result: The fixed bench builds and runs with the reference module, so a build failure, an abnormal end, a missing or incomplete observation record and an explicit mismatch are FAIL (1). Missing fixed tools or inputs, resource exhaustion and wall-clock timeouts are INVALID (2).
